artworks.title: Nude Study
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a seated individual facing left with a slightly tilted head, one knee bent upwards. The upper body and arms of the figure are visible, with a profile face showing delicate features and hair styled back neatly. The person is minimally draped with loose fabric around the lower body, and the torso and arms are bare. In the background, there are faint outlines of an abstract form at the top left and a sketch of a hand at the right, with the rest of the backdrop mostly plain.

artworks.title: Nude with Cherub Holding a Mirror
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure with the upper body and arms raised, possibly stretching or adjusting their hair. Their long hair cascades downwards, accompanied by delicate facial features. The figure appears to be unclothed, with portions of the legs and feet also visible, draped in fabric around the lower body. Beside them, a small winged figure holds a rounded mirror or disk. The background features a mix of vertical and horizontal shading, suggesting an outdoor or nature-like setting with the presence of tall, thin plants or trees. The overall tone of the image is rendered in soft, dark tones.

artworks.title: Nude with Cupid
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper half of a woman's body alongside a cherubic figure. The woman is in a seated position, with her torso slightly turned to the side. Her facial features are depicted with soft shading, with a calm expression, her hair styled in an updo, partially covered by a cloth. She is holding a rose in one hand with detailed petals visible. The cherubic figure leans against her, with curly hair and small wings visible. Both figures are unclothed apart from a drape around the woman’s lower body. The background consists of a textured, abstract pattern.

artworks.title: Blue Nude
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person standing upright in a three-quarter profile view, facing left. The person is in a relaxed pose, with the right arm bent, hand near the neck, and the left arm hanging by their side. The individual has shoulder-length curly hair and delicate facial features, with a slight upward tilt of the chin. The person appears nude, with emphasis on subtle shading and body contours. The background is a warm beige tone, providing a simple and neutral backdrop. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects held by the figure.

artworks.title: Birch Boughs, Catskill Mountains
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of tree branches and leaves. The view is directed upwards, capturing the intricate network of branches and foliage with detailed pencil work. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, emphasizing the texture and form of the leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of gray on a beige background to create depth and subtle shadowing. The absence of bold colors or strong contrasts allows the viewer to appreciate the detail and texture of the leaves.

artworks.title: Lake of Brienz
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground. In the background, there are mountains with snow or light covering them, and a church with a pointed steeple is visible towards the left. The sketch uses a loose and delicate technique with gentle, flowing lines to depict the scenery. The color palette is mostly muted browns and beiges. There are some animals and vegetation near the water, and the overall atmosphere is calm and serene.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with rolling hills, mountains, trees, and rocky terrain. The horizon is high in the composition, with mountains in the distance. The drawing style is sketchy with different pencil strokes for trees and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic with gray tones on a beige background.

artworks.title: Tahomet
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Arthur B. Davies, wife of the artist, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile with arms straight up above their head, standing on their toes with a slightly arched back. The person has short, dark hair and subtle facial features. They wear minimal clothing resembling shorts or a loincloth. The background is a simple, solid gray tone.

artworks.title: The Signal
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on two sheets of blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Arthur B. Davies, wife of the artist, 1930)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back facing the viewer. They have their left arm extended upward and their right arm bent behind their head. The person has short, curly hair and is wearing a rectangular cloth draped over their lower back to upper thighs. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the initials "R.E." in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: The Art Class
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals in a room. In the foreground, a woman with an updo is seated on a bench. To the left, a man in a suit with short hair and a beard is seated facing a painting. On the far right, another woman with an updo and a detailed dress stands next to a seated man in formal attire. Another woman, possibly standing, is behind the easel. The background features a patterned wall or curtain.

artworks.title: An Intimate Concert
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch depicting two figures, primarily showing their upper bodies and portions of their lower bodies. One figure is seated and embracing a large, stringed instrument similar to a lute or mandolin, which is resting on their lap. This figure appears to be gently leaning forward, their face featuring distinct curls cascading over the forehead, indicating curly hair, with facial features stooped and slightly angled downwards. The second figure is positioned close behind the first, intimately leaning over the shoulder of the first figure, and seems to be attentively observing either the player or the instrument. This figure has a head full of curls and a more defined outline of facial features. Both figures are clothed in flowing garments, with the fabric draping around them, indicating robes or classical attire. The background is plain, highlighting the soft shadows and lines of the figures, with faint sketched lines suggesting setting suggestions rather than clear details. There are no prominent accessories or jewelry visible on the figures.

artworks.title: An Imperial Tomb: Elevation and Ground Plan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash over blind stylus on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The image depicts a detailed plan and elevation of a monumental building or a triumphal arch, characterized by ornamental sculptures and reliefs. The drawing is meticulously crafted with precise lines depicting the architectural design, including niches with statues, decorative panels, and arches. Two figures are placed at elevated positions, likely representing sculptures or statues. The structure features a central arch with a relief above it and the lower portion of the image shows what appears to be the floor plan, indicating the spatial arrangement and design elements, such as the placement of walls and columns. The entire image gives the impression of a carefully thought-out architectural masterpiece. The drawing showcases strong attention to symmetrical details and artistic embellishments typical of classical architecture.

artworks.title: A Standing Male Nude
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping on tracing paper, squared for transfer
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a person in a side profile. The person has a hunched-over posture, with their head slightly bowed and arms crossed in front of their chest. The facial features are softly rendered, eyes looking downward, and long flowing hair draping around the face and down the back. The figure is unclothed, shaded with pencil strokes to suggest form and volume. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The sketch is on brown paper with a grid likely for proportional reference.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Enthroned, Adored by Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper with separate sheet pasted down
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with figures and cherubs. The image depicts an elevated figure seated on a large pedestal or throne, holding a small child. Below, a group of ornate figures, including one with a mitre and a staff, appears to be in adoration or prayer, directed towards the seated figure. To the right, cherubs are depicted flying amidst clouds. The use of sepia tones and fluid lines creates a timeless atmosphere. The scene is set indoors, as suggested by the decorated architectural elements such as drapery and garlands. The drawing is intricate, with a focus on the clothing and expressions of the figures, as well as the interaction between them and the celestial beings above.

artworks.title: Satan Defying the Powers of Heaven
artworks.medium: graphite, black chalk, and brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: From below, we look up at a nude, muscular man striding from one dark gray boulder to another against a mist-gray background in this vertical drawing. The man’s right knee, to our left, is bent as he leans onto that leg. His other leg is stretched behind him so the foot reaches into the lower right corner of the sheet. The man holds his left arm, to our right, high with that hand in a fist, and he turns his head to look in that direction. A white drapery swirls up and behind the man’s shoulders. The background is mostly washes of muted, slate gray with a darker flint-gray area to the left. The man’s body is outlined lightly in graphite and chalk and more lines create a loose, angular grid across the background. The sheet has a crease across its middle.

artworks.title: Saint-Sauveur. Sentier du chaos conduisant à Gavarnie (Saint-Sauveur. The Path to Chaos Leading to Gavarnie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr., New York, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged mountain path winding through a rocky landscape. The point of view is from the path, with a turn and upward slope visible. There is a low horizon, barely visible beyond the rocky terrain. The path ascends towards it, flanked by steep, rocky inclines. The towering rocky hills dominate the scene, with a hint of sky at the top. The image has a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing texture and shadows of the rocks. The rocky landscape is detailed and rugged, with variations in light and shadow.

artworks.title: An Ancient Door, Magdalen College, Oxford
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Carolyn Schwenker Brody, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate architectural doorway. The image shows a high-contrast, sepia-toned picture of a Gothic-style church entrance, characterized by a pointed arch and detailed stone carvings. Above the doorway, there is decorative stonework with small statues set within niches. The door is wooden, set within a heavy stone frame. The stone facade is partially covered in climbing plants, and the building's texture is enhanced by the lighting, which casts deep shadows accentuating the architectural details.

artworks.title: The Harbor at Viareggio [La Darsena]
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with boats moored by the water's edge. The horizon is depicted with a sea wall, small figures, and street lamps. The artwork uses fine etched lines to create a sketch-like texture with shadows. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of gray and black, highlighting the contrasts between the boats, water, and sky. The boats closest to the viewer are outlined with scribbled strokes to show reflections. Structures in the harbor and distant figures are less detailed, softened by the etching style. The sky has lightly etched strokes indicating overcast or slightly cloudy weather.

artworks.title: Seated Man in Sixteenth-Century Costume
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a bench with one leg crossed over the other. They lean forward with an arm resting on the seat back. The individual's facial features are partially in profile, with dark hair. They wear a loose garment. The background is textured with a combination of cross-hatching and shading, creating light and dark contrasts.

artworks.title: Luisa Carmignani, the Artist's Mother-in-Law
artworks.medium: pastel and white tempera on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman in profile, wearing a dark garment with a high collar. She has a serene expression, with features including a prominent nose and defined wrinkles suggesting age. Her hair is styled in a low bun, and she wears a long, elegant earring. The background is textured with gray and beige tones.

artworks.title: Portrait of Five Children
artworks.description: The image depicts five children. Four are seated in a formal portrait style, with one taller child standing behind. The standing child is a young boy with short, neatly combed hair, dressed in a suit with a double-breasted jacket and a bow tie. Two girls seated in the middle have their hair pulled back and are wearing dresses with puffed sleeves and lace gloves, one holding a baby on her lap. The baby is dressed in a light gown with short sleeves and very short hair. A girl on the left with long, wavy hair rests her arm around the baby, and the girl on the far right has a similar hairstyle and holds a fan. All children wear traditional formal attire typical of the era. They are posed on an ornate, upholstered piece of furniture in what appears to be a photography studio. The background is a simple plain backdrop, emphasizing formality. The photograph is bordered by an ornate gold frame within a case.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man seated. He is facing forward with his hands in his lap. The man has a gaunt face, sharp features, and thin lips. He wears round glasses, a dark top hat, a jacket, a waistcoat, a white shirt with a cravat or necktie. The background is neutral and the portrait is presented in a gold-edged frame on a golden textured backing.

artworks.title: Owasco Lake, Cascade
artworks.description: The image depicts a view down railway tracks stretching into the distance, flanked by a river on the right and houses on an embankment on the left. Utility poles line the tracks. A person in formal attire walks on a path near the tracks. The scene is captured in early black and white photography, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of gray.
